name: Changyu Holding Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Changyu Holding Group Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells chemicals in China. It offers nylon, which includes long-chain nylon, transparent nylon, reinforces nylon quick connectors, new energy thermal management system, nylon elastomer, semi-aromatic nylon, and automotive and transportation pipe; long-chain dicarboxylic acids that comprise Undecanedicarboxylic acid UDDA, dodecanedicarboxylic acid DDDA, tridecanedicarboxylic acid, tetradecanedicarboxylic acid, pentadecanedicarboxylic acid, hexadecanedicarboxylic acid, and 1,8-octamic acid; and 1,13-tetanediol, 1,7-heptanediol, 1,8-octanediol, 1,9-nonadiol, 1,10-decanediol, 1,11-undecanediol, 1,12-dodecanediol, and 1,14-tetradecanediol.
